trip.title: Algonquin Fall Colour Day
trip.summary: Toronto → North York pickup → seven short stops for colour and photos → home around 10 PM. No trail over 2.1 km.
trip.route: 401 W → 400 N → Hwy 11 N → Hwy 60 E

bestSpot.heading: Don't miss: Lookout Trail
bestSpot.lead: If you only have time for one stop, make it this one. The ridge at the top looks out over several hundred square kilometres of Algonquin.

points.label: Where
points.text: km 39.7, north side of Hwy 60, 3 km before the Visitor Centre

points.label: Planned
points.text: 2:15 PM, about 1 hour on the trail

points.label: Effort
points.text: 2.1 km loop, rated Difficult: steep and rocky, but short

points.label: Parking
points.text: Small lot that fills first. If full, do Spruce Bog and come back

points.label: Photo tip
points.text: Frame the view with the white pines at the edge of the ridge

source.name: Friends of Algonquin Park: Lookout Trail

permit.name: DVP – Hwy 60 (does not include Booth's Rock Trail)
permit.validHours: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM on the date of issue
permit.covers: One vehicle and all occupants (up to 14). All Highway 60 corridor stops in this plan.
doesNotCover: Other Algonquin access points (Achray, Kiosk, Brent, etc.)
Booth's Rock Trail (sold out for Oct 17)

timeline.title: Pickup in North York
timeline.note: 401 W → 400 N → Hwy 11 N → Hwy 60 E

timeline.title: Huntsville
timeline.note: Gas, washroom, coffee, and pick up lunch to go. Last good fuel stop.

timeline.title: West Gate (km 0)
timeline.note: No stopping needed. Your plate is your permit.

timeline.title: Head home
timeline.note: Dusk falls fast. Drive slowly and watch for moose.

timeline.title: Dinner in Huntsville
timeline.note: See Food for vegan and chicken picks.

stops.name: Whiskey Rapids Trail
stops.description: Rapids and riverside colour along the Oxtongue River. Easy.
stops.parking: Small trailhead lot right off Hwy 60 at km 7.2.

photo.alt: The Oxtongue River along the Whiskey Rapids Trail in early October

stops.name: Lake of Two Rivers picnic area
stops.parking: Picnic-area lot at km 33.8, a short walk to the tables and beach. Washrooms and bins here.

photo.alt: Fall colours on the shore of Lake of Two Rivers

stops.name: Two Rivers Trail
stops.description: Short climb to a pine-topped cliff over the river valley.
stops.parking: Small trailhead lot at km 31.1. Drive back 3 km west from lunch.

stops.name: Lookout Trail
stops.description: The best view in the park, with hills and lakes in every direction. Steep and rugged. If the lot is full, do Spruce Bog first.
stops.parking: Small lot at km 39.7 that fills first. If full, go on to Spruce Bog and come back after.

photo.alt: White pines framing the view from Lookout Trail over autumn forest and Lake of Two Rivers

stops.name: Spruce Bog Boardwalk
stops.description: Flat boardwalk through gold tamaracks, the strongest colour in mid-October.
stops.parking: Trailhead lot at km 42.5, about 1 minute from the Visitor Centre.

photo.alt: Sunday Creek Bog seen from the Spruce Bog Boardwalk in early October

stops.name: Visitor Centre deck
stops.description: Huge panorama with no walking, plus washrooms. Closes at 5 PM.
stops.parking: Large lot, the biggest in the corridor. Best fallback if other lots are full.

photo.alt: Fall colour view from the Visitor Centre over the Sunday Creek valley

stops.name: Beaver Pond Trail
stops.description: Beaver dams, ponds and a rocky viewpoint in late golden light.

photo.alt: Golden grasses around the beaver pond beside Beaver Pond Trail

backups.name: Hemlock Bluff
backups.note: Quieter, cliff view of Jack Lake

backups.name: Logging Museum Trail
backups.parking: Large lot, plus overflow at Leaf Lake across the road

food.note: There's no reliable food stop inside the park. Vegan menus change, so confirm at the counter.

places.name: Osmow's Shawarma
places.chicken: Chicken shawarma wrap or rice bowl
places.vegan: Falafel wrap or bowl; ask which sauces are vegan

places.name: Main St. Local Kitchen
places.vegan: Ask the kitchen; they handle dietary requests well

places.name: Gangnam Korea
places.chicken: Korean fried chicken (bone-in is halal) or spicy chicken rice bowl
places.vegan: Ask for a tofu or veggie rice bowl without egg

places.name: The Mill on Main
places.vegan: Black bean veggie burger or power bowl; ask for no dairy

places.name: Fox in the Henhouse
places.chicken: Fried chicken sandwiches, the local favourite
places.vegan: Any sandwich with crispy tofu instead of chicken; check the sauce

tips: Gold tamaracks, birch and aspen are the colours now. Most red maples have dropped.
Still water at Two Rivers and Beaver Pond gives the best reflections.
Use HDR or a polarizer so the yellows pop against sky and water.
Cold drains phone batteries fast. Bring a power bank, gloves and a toque.
Wear shoes with grip. Rocks and leaves can be frosty in the morning.
